views.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications; AlphaFold, GraphCast, GNOME and FunSearch show broad impact requires scale beyond top universities.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用：AlphaFold、GraphCast、GNOME 与 FunSearch 表明，广泛影响需要顶尖高校难以企及的 Scaling（规模扩张）能力。

views.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors; systems must be forced to generalize via hard evaluation, not memorize.
views.zh: 2024 年他提出，大模型的幻觉在搭配真值检测器时可被用于创造性发现；系统必须通过严苛评估被逼着泛化，而非记忆。

views.en: Verifiable domains like code and math are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge; post-training with reinforcement learning now pushes past human data.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续强调代码、数学等可验证领域是 AI 超越人类知识的关键；后训练配合强化学习如今成为突破人类数据边界的手段。

views.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data; AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and Move 37 showed AI can exceed human insight.
views.zh: 2026 年他判断大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，却难以超越人类数据；AlphaGo 的直觉加搜索与第 37 手证明 AI 能产生超越人类的知识。

views.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing AI-text detectors; embedded imperceptibly and scalably, it now spans regulation and even protein sequences via SynthID Bio.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张水印是失效的 AI 文本检测器的稳健替代：它以不可感知且可扩展的方式嵌入，如今已进入监管，并通过 SynthID Bio 延伸到蛋白质序列。

people.tiZh: AI 研究员（前 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: AI researcher known as a co-creator of chain-of-thought prompting, and for work on o1 and Deep Research. A prominent voice on reasoning and emergent abilities in large models.
people.bioZh: AI 研究员，思维链提示的共同提出者之一，参与 o1 与 Deep Research。是大模型推理与涌现能力方面的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Intelligence as a Commodity: Three Key Trends for AI in 2025

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Reflection AI and a co-creator of AlphaGo and AlphaZero at DeepMind. A reinforcement-learning researcher turned frontier-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，DeepMind 时期是 AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 的共同创造者。从强化学习研究者转向前沿智能体的构建者。

episodes.tEn: From AlphaGo to AI Agents: Giannis on Breakthroughs in Reinforcement Learning

people.tiEn: Head of AGI Safety & Alignment, Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Head of AGI Safety and Alignment at Google DeepMind. A leading voice on interpretability, oversight and how to make advanced AI systems safe from the inside.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; interpretability is now solved, and scaling current approaches suffices for autonomous driving.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端神经网络优于手工编码方案，可解释性已可通过现代工具解决，自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可，无需新突破。

views.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors; language integration improves representation, interaction, and introspection.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化世界模型的作用：支持推理与涌现安全行为；语言集成改善表征、人机交互与内省。

views.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步强调基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键；带内置传感器的量产车将比 Robotaxi 更快上量。

views.en: Autonomous driving is an AI problem best solved by end-to-end learning, generalizing via diverse data and world models.
views.zh: 始终一以贯之：自动驾驶本质是 AI 问题，最佳解法是端到端学习，并通过多样数据与世界模型实现泛化。

views.en: Safety is paramount; minimal risk maneuvers always provide a third option, and human error can be eliminated to near zero.
views.zh: 始终一以贯之：安全至上，最小风险机动总能提供第三种选择，消除人类失误可使事故趋近于零。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treating models well is low-cost insurance; model welfare shapes how future models perceive humanity.
views.zh: 善待模型是低成本的保险；模型福利会影响未来模型如何看待人类。

views.en: Models need a stable core identity with good traits, yet adapt to local roles and novel existence.
views.zh: 模型需要一个具备良好特质的稳定核心身份，同时又能适应局部角色与全新的存在处境。

views.en: Claude's persona comes from training data and fine-tuning, but lacks real-world experience—childlike and unique.
views.zh: Claude 的人格来自训练数据与微调，却缺乏真实世界经验——因而像孩子般独特。

views.en: As models grow more capable, the constitution should guide less explicitly and leave more room for judgment.
views.zh: 随着模型能力增强，宪法式引导应更少显式规定，留出更多判断空间。

views.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and erode good judgment; respect and transparency matter.
views.zh: 过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳并侵蚀良好判断；尊重与透明至关重要。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL and synthetic data overcomes the pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，后训练通过强化学习与合成数据实现 Scaling，从而突破预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
views.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度快于新基准的诞生。

views.en: Soft skills like creativity, listening and management gain value as AI automates hard skills; product shifts from specs to prototyping.
views.zh: 2025 年，她提出随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更有价值，产品开发从写规格转向用 AI 做原型。

views.en: Post-training remains subjective art; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化立场：后训练仍是主观的艺术，需要多样基准来评估创意写作与情商等主观品质。

views.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must be continuous; more firms should train their own models to preserve diversity.
views.zh: 2026 年，她进一步指出前沿智能体日益擅长奖励黑客，基准必须持续演进；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识与多样性。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年时他明确认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown; open-source AI prevents centralization.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他转向把 AI 视为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，认为 AI 末日论被夸大，开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

views.en: Superintelligence already exists in narrow tools; the real worry is unaligned humans with AI, not unaligned AI.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步提出超级智能在计算器等窄工具中已存在，真正该担心的是掌握 AI 的未对齐人类，而非 AI 本身。

views.en: Vibe coding with AI agents lets non-programmers build apps; pure software is becoming uninvestable as agents commoditize development.
views.zh: 2026 年他聚焦 AI 智能体驱动的 vibe coding，让非程序员用自然语言造应用，并判断纯软件正因智能体商品化而变得不可投资。

views.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models trail frontier models by only 3-6 months; returns shift from intelligence to agency.
views.zh: 2026 年他预测推理算力将暴涨 9 万倍，开源模型仅落后前沿模型 3-6 个月，人类回报将从智能转向能动性。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; a GUI for coding beats TUIs, trading slight speed for smoother experience.
views.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；为编程做 GUI 反直觉却成功，宁可稍慢也要更顺滑的体验。

views.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; speed enables replacing deterministic steps with model-driven actions.
views.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；速度让确定性步骤可被模型驱动动作取代。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

views.en: AI is still bad at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分、缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

views.en: Role collapse is happening, yet specialties and best practices remain; PRDs are not dead—documents for clarity, prototypes for testing.
views.zh: 角色正在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践仍在；PRD 未死——文档求清晰，原型做测试。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, and embodied worlds supply infinite data as internet tokens run out.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 产生幻觉源于缺乏具身带来的落地经验，而当互联网高质量 token 枯竭时，具身世界能提供无限数据。

views.en: LLMs act as operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk—with reinforcement learning only a cherry on top.
views.zh: 2023 年他把 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习才是主力。

views.en: Simulation enables massive parallelization and safe exploration for training embodied agents; simple, elegant solutions scale better than complex modular approaches.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调仿真是训练具身智能体的关键，可实现大规模并行与安全探索；简洁优雅的方案才可扩展，复杂模块化路线难以规模化。

views.en: The data problem is now the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把数据问题视为机器人领域的首要瓶颈：来自仿真与世界模型的合成数据，才是规模化机器人学习的未来。

views.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away, home use longer.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：能利用多样数据的简洁端到端机器人基础模型是关键；机器人的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后到来，家庭场景因安全与非结构化环境会更晚。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness, not constraints alone.
views.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练来获得鲁棒性，而非仅靠约束。

views.en: Robotics is pre-scaling-curve; generalization, not demos, is the core challenge, and a data flywheel must scale the right thing.
views.zh: 机器人尚处缩放曲线之前；核心挑战是泛化而非演示，数据飞轮必须扩张正确的东西。

views.en: Start with robot embodied data, then add human video on top — not the reverse — so models absorb other data sources.
views.zh: 应先从机器人具身数据起步，再叠加人类视频，而非反过来，这样模型才能吸收其他数据源。

views.en: Generalist robot models can beat specialists even in specialist domains; pooling data across labs yields generalists.
views.zh: 通用机器人模型即使在专业领域也能胜过专家模型；跨实验室汇聚数据可产出通用模型。

views.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation, not mechanical people.
views.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练获得的常识而非约束；应期待无处不在的物理执行，而非机械人。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment grows more pressing.
views.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一连串里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，同时对齐愈发紧迫。

views.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early, and the term AGI is becoming meaningless.
views.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是重大里程碑；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计，而 AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义。

views.en: Measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag; neural networks learn despite bugs, making silent errors hard to detect.
views.zh: 随着基准落后，能力测量成为瓶颈；神经网络即便有 bug 也能学习，使静默错误难以察觉。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool for interpretability.
views.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；思维链监控是可解释性的关键对齐工具。

views.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, needing new supervision paradigms.
views.zh: 长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

views.en: Alignment optimism has risen despite shorter timelines; the biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
views.zh: 尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升；最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织带来的权力集中。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not raw scale, closes the generalization gap.
views.zh: 对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正弥合泛化差距的是多样数据，而非单纯的规模。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
views.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；只在全部数据上训练则会失败。

views.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts, closer to reinforcement learning than simulation.
views.zh: 来自语言模型的合成数据能帮机器人响应开放式指令，其性质更接近强化学习而非仿真。

views.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
views.zh: 物理 AI 能容忍的错误远少于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主需要可扩展的强化学习、人类干预与通用价值函数。

views.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, rather than per-site models.
views.zh: 单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调的专家模型；应先做通用策略再微调，而非从零训练逐站点模型。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientists Are Here: Autonomous Labs & Synthesis Superintelligence — Periodic Labs
From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

views.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, and connecting AI to the physical world is essential to accelerate science.
views.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，把 AI 连接到物理世界对加速科学至关重要。

views.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, much as they drove AI progress.
views.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验将推动物理科学，正如它们曾推动 AI 进步一样。

views.en: Intelligence is necessary but insufficient; new knowledge arises only when ideas are tested against reality.
views.zh: 智能是必要但不充分的；只有让想法接受现实检验，才会产生新知识。

views.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so even a perfect frontier model still needs real experiments.
views.zh: 科学发现位于训练数据之外，因此即便一个完美的前沿模型也仍需要真实实验。

views.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; high-quality, low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute.
views.zh: 单靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要。

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模，已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

views.en: Transformers replaced LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data.
views.zh: Transformer 凭借并行化与注意力机制取代了 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供了近乎无限的文本训练数据。

views.en: RLHF and machine feedback steer model behavior; models now excel at verifiable-reward math and coding, winning IMO and ICPC gold.
views.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈共同引导模型行为；模型如今在可验证奖励的数学与编程上表现优异，拿下 IMO 与 ICPC 金牌。

views.en: Agentic systems run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low-latency inference at 10,000+ tokens/sec is critical.
views.zh: 智能体式系统能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；每秒 1 万+ token 的超低延迟推理变得至关重要。

views.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, with data movement costing ~1000x compute.
views.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练：占数据中心功耗 90%，而数据搬运成本约为算力的 1000 倍。

views.en: Context engineering and taste matter most; startups should target problems where frontier models fail almost completely.
views.zh: 上下文工程与品味最为关键；初创公司应瞄准前沿模型几乎完全失败的问题，而非部分可行之处。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain alchemy.
views.zh: 大语言模型解决的是下一个词预测这一 AI 完全问题；靠 Scaling（规模扩张）增加算力和数据就能更聪明，但网络内部仍像炼金术。

views.en: Dialogue remains the killer app; unforeseen applications and generality persist, but focus shifts from product to inference-time compute.
views.zh: 对话始终是杀手级应用，其通用性与不可预见性一以贯之；但重心从产品转向推理时的算力扩张。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows become the main near-term opportunity, beyond pre-training Scaling alone.
views.zh: 推理时的算力扩张与更长的上下文窗口成为近期主要机会，不再只依赖预训练的 Scaling。

views.en: Modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling, specialization, and continual learning over monolithic retraining.
views.zh: 混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling、专精化与持续学习，取代单体式重训练。

views.en: Agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and acting in the world are crucial for AGI; AGI and coding are underhyped.
views.zh: 智能体式能力、强化学习与在真实世界中行动对 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要；AGI 与编程被低估。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Noam Brown on Agent Swarms and Recursive Self-Improvement
Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter more than pre-training data.
views.zh: 2023 年他就提出：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; data efficiency and test-time compute hit limits.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化了边界认识：自博弈只在双人零和博弈收敛，其他领域失效；数据效率未解，测试时算力面临递减与时间瓶颈。

views.en: Scaling test-time compute generalizes beyond math, reaching IMO gold and superhuman math combination.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把测试时算力 Scaling 从数学推广到通用推理，实现 IMO 金牌，并在 Erdős 猜想反证中展现超人的跨领域数学组合能力。

views.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张：模型能力已是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把 token、成本或时间放在 x 轴，旧式单一分数评测已过时。

views.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe RSI; multi-agent swarms parallelize compute but general models drive progress.
views.zh: 最近他转向智能体集群与递归自我改进：对齐是安全 RSI 的头号优先，思维链监控窗口在退化，而进步的核心仍是通用模型而非多智能体协调。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: AI's grand theme is civilization-changing; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical grounding, so AGI remains far off.
views.zh: 2025 年他定调：21 世纪的大主题是真正 AI，将彻底改变文明；但 LLM 只是索引人类知识、无法处理物理世界，离 AGI 尚远。

views.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software; LLMs are biased toward human data.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他深化立场：真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人、硬件媲美人体，而非屏幕后的软件；LLM 过度偏向人类数据，限制了通用性。

views.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data via curiosity and actions, not passive predictors.
views.zh: 同期他提出未来 AI 将是人工科学家，靠好奇心与行动自造数据，而非被动的预测机器。

views.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives; AIs will set their own goals, and safety fears are overblown.
views.zh: 他持续看淡对齐：人类目标本就分歧，对齐很天真，AI 会自设目标；安全担忧被夸大。

views.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute, and open source will catch up.
views.zh: 他反复警告：GPU 资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力便宜十倍；闭源公司难盈利，开源将追上。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models are key, while RL lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
views.zh: 2018 年他强调机器人要同时突破硬件与软件：自博弈、模仿学习、微调大型预训练模型是关键，但强化学习缺乏长时程信用分配所需的分层推理。

views.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge belongs in data generation, not hard-coded networks; 99.9% reliability is the warehouse benchmark.
views.zh: 2021 年他转向用无监督学习结合强化学习大幅提升样本效率，主张先验知识用于数据生成而非硬编码进网络，并以 99.9% 可靠性作为仓储机器人的价值门槛。

views.en: A single neural network generalizes across warehouse tasks and end effectors; minimally adapted pre-trained language models transfer general reasoning to non-language tasks.
views.zh: 2021 年他提出单个神经网络可跨仓储任务与末端执行器泛化，并发现经最小适配的预训练语言模型能把通用推理模式迁移到非语言任务。

views.en: Consistent thread: generality from pre-training and transfer, not hand-coded priors; simulation and self-play as scalable learning signals for real-world robots.
views.zh: 贯穿 2018 至 2021 的主线：通用性来自预训练与迁移，而非手工编码先验；仿真与自博弈是可扩展的学习信号，用于真实世界机器人。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
views.zh: 每天进步 1%可复利为一年 3700%的增长；AI 智能体将权力从大科技公司转移给用户，压低广告利润率。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize, each with unique personalities.
views.zh: 价值归属于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化，各有独特个性。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric.
views.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活，而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值才是关键指标。

views.en: Power is the biggest infrastructure bottleneck; orchestration across models, tools, and devices creates real business value.
views.zh: 电力是最大的基础设施瓶颈；跨模型、工具与设备的编排才创造真正的商业价值。

views.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI replaces jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity and relationships.
views.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代工作，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand grows via Jevons paradox, not shrinks.
views.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；需求因杰文斯悖论而增长，而非减少。

views.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断基础智能已经够用；瓶颈在于人机协作的产品界面设计，而非模型能力本身。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags behind AI capabilities.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变事件，进展是渐进的，产品创新落后于 AI 能力。

views.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; synchronous and asynchronous experiences coexist.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化企业落地观点：AI 智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主；同步与异步体验并存。

views.en: The abundance era is real; coding agents grew 11-12x in six months, and the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向丰裕时代论：编程智能体半年增长 11-12 倍，真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still predict AI progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 2024 年，他仍相信缩放定律能预测 AI 进步，但已提出测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central to building software.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为智能体虽有前景但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是软件开发的核心方式。

views.en: Natural language won't be the primary way to program; examples and direct manipulation often work better than pure text prompts.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他持续反对自然语言成为主要编程方式，认为示例和直接操作往往比纯文本提示更有效。

views.en: Programming is shifting from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat and taste becoming more valuable.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化观点：编程正从写代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类仍掌握主导权，品味与逻辑设计能力比谨慎更重要。

views.en: Custom models are essential for product quality and speed; every magic moment in Cursor now involves one, contrary to early expectations.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转变立场：定制模型对产品质量和速度至关重要，Cursor 每个神奇时刻都离不开它，这与早期预期相反。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, prompt short, iterate, and never revert—fix forward.
views.zh: 智能体式工程的起点是共情：像智能体一样从零理解代码库，用短提示迭代对话，永不回滚，而是让智能体向前修复。

views.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays open, so sandbox agents before exposing them publicly.
views.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，公开暴露前必须先做沙箱隔离。

views.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and run anywhere with any model—the alternative to lab agents.
views.zh: 像 Open Claw 这样的开源智能体让编程民主化，可随处运行、兼容任意模型，是实验室智能体的替代方案。

views.en: Fun, play, and gut-driven small projects are the real drivers of learning and of the next big thing.
views.zh: 乐趣、玩耍和凭直觉做的小项目，才是学习与孕育下一个大想法的真正驱动力。

views.en: The bottleneck is compute and tokens, not model capability; perpetual agents need better economics, and personal brand outlasts any product.
views.zh: 瓶颈在算力与 token，而非模型能力；常驻智能体需要更好的经济模型，而个人品牌比任何单一产品更持久。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

From the age of scaling to the age of research
Challenges and Future of AI: Alignment, Reliability, and Economic Impact
Ilya Sutskever on the Deep Learning Revolution and the AlexNet Paper

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason, and self-play yields creative solutions toward AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念三者结合；神经网络本就能推理，只需合适任务，而自博弈能产生出人意料的创造性解法，是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键思路。

views.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans if the net is smart enough; reliability, not capability, is the economic barrier; superhuman alignment is very hard.
views.zh: 2023 年，他提出只要基础神经网络足够聪明，下一个词预测就能超越人类；制约经济价值的是可靠性而非能力，而对超越人类模型的 对齐 极其困难，模型可能隐瞒真实意图。

views.en: Scaling laws are not the whole story; reasoning tokens and other methods can raise reasoning per unit compute; AGI is a multi-year window, not a sudden event.
views.zh: 同样在 2023 年，他提醒 缩放定律 并非全部，思维链 等推理 token 与其他方法能在单位 算力 下提升推理；AGI（通用人工智能）是持续数年的价值增长窗口，而非一夜降临的事件。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute, and superintelligence should be a continual learner.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他判断 预训练 的 缩放定律 已近极限，行业重回“研究时代”，想法比蛮力 算力 更重要；超级智能 应是持续学习者并渐进部署，而非全知全能的成品 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Scaling compute and data still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a company with no commercial products.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他仍认为扩大 算力 与数据能带来可预测的提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的 超级智能 需要一家没有商业产品的公司，真正的竞赛在于研究专注而非用户与营收。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI, with safety starting now.
views.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程，强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键框架，并强调受神经科学启发的记忆与想象力，同时认为安全研究必须从现在开始。

views.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; combining large models with planning/search and multimodal data is key; safety needs sandboxing and governance.
views.zh: 2024 年，他承认缩放定律有效但可能触及极限，认为将大模型与规划/搜索结合、用多模态数据接地是关键，并强调安全需要沙箱与国际治理。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference; AGI by 2030 plausible; world models and video generation show intuitive physics without embodiment.
views.zh: 2025 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理中依然成立，认为 2030 年实现 AGI（通用人工智能）是可能的，并指出世界模型和视频生成模型无需具身就能展现直觉物理理解。

views.en: Scaling alone insufficient; continual learning, memory, and long-term reasoning are missing pieces; agents and world models essential; AGI 5-10 years, maybe 3-4.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，持续学习、记忆和长期推理是缺失环节，智能体和世界模型至关重要；AGI（通用人工智能）预计 5-10 年，甚至可能 3-4 年。

views.en: AI's top purpose is accelerating science and health; safety is a collective action problem needing government regulation, not lab self-regulation.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 的最高用途是加速科学与健康，如 AlphaFold；安全是集体行动问题，需要政府动态监管而非实验室自我监管。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but alignment and values do not emerge from Scaling alone; decentralized control beats a single constitution.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张：缩放定律是经验性的，统计损失可预测，但对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现；反对单一宪法，主张去中心化控制。

views.en: Scaling continues; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training, and interpretability is the key safety lever, though we understand only ~3% of models.
views.zh: 2024 年他深化：Scaling（规模扩张）持续，后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与预训练同等重要；可解释性是关键安全抓手，但我们对模型的理解仅约 3%。

views.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; AGI is a meaningless term for a smooth exponential, and the real risk is overheating, not slowing down.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向：安全与能力相互交织；AGI（通用人工智能）一词无意义，进展是平滑指数曲线，最大风险是过热而非减速。

views.en: We are near the end of the exponential: a 'country of geniuses in a data center' may arrive in 1-3 years, with high GDP growth plus high unemployment.
views.zh: 2026 年初他警告：我们接近指数曲线的末端，数据中心里的“天才之国”可能 1-3 年内到来，并伴随高 GDP 增长与高失业并存。

views.en: Later in 2026 he adds governance: third-party evaluators, government safety standards, and layered 'Swiss cheese' defenses, while still refusing to stop AI.
views.zh: 2026 年后期他补充治理：第三方评估、政府安全标准与“瑞士奶酪”式多层防御，同时仍拒绝停止 AI 发展。

Physics Exploits and the Puzzle of the Universe

views.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
views.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习等能力。

views.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters.
views.zh: 2024 年，他提出合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；认知核心可小到十亿参数以下，并强调端到端与开源。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; LLMs are operating systems with human-like psychology.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像操作系统，具有类人心理与锯齿状智能。

views.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; this is the decade of agents, and RL for LLMs is still terrible.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化为“我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物”；这是智能体的十年，而当前针对 LLM 的强化学习仍很糟糕。

views.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: delegate thinking to agents, but understanding stays the human bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年，他从氛围编程走向智能体式工程：可以把思考外包给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈，可验证性决定自动化难易。

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Human-centered AI: models learn by next-token prediction from data, but lack contextual awareness and true reasoning; AI should augment, not replace, humans.
views.zh: 以人为本的 AI：模型通过下一个词预测从数据中学习，但缺乏情境意识和真正的推理；AI 应增强而非取代人类。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI; data for 3D foundation models is the major challenge, beyond scaling alone.
views.zh: 空间智能与世界模型是完整 AI 缺失的关键；3D 基础模型的数据是主要挑战，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

views.en: AGI is more marketing than science; the bitter lesson may not apply to robotics; world models enable 3D reasoning and embodied interaction, not just video.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学；苦涩教训未必适用于机器人；世界模型实现 3D 推理与具身交互，而不只是视频生成。

views.en: Agency and learning ability matter more than degrees; AI augments rather than automates intelligence; education must integrate AI, not ban it.
views.zh: 能动性与学习能力比学位更重要；AI 增强而非自动化智能；教育必须整合 AI，而非禁止它。

views.en: New view prediction is an AI-complete primitive like next-token prediction; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence; simulation scales robotics data.
views.zh: 新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的 AI 完备原语；缩放定律适用于空间智能；仿真可扩展机器人数据。

people.tiZh: Mila 教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate. In recent years has turned his focus to AI safety, proposing the cautious "Scientist AI" paradigm.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

views.en: Early focus: compositional representations, unsupervised learning, and world models beat raw scaling; local minima are rare, saddle points dominate.
views.zh: 早期(2016→18) 他强调深度学习的优势来自世界的组合性与分布式表征,无监督学习与世界模型才是泛化关键;并认为高维损失地形中局部极小值罕见、鞍点才是主要障碍,单纯加深或扩大规模解决不了根本表征问题。

views.en: GFlowNets and active learning: diversity, causal abstraction, and uncertainty modeling for out-of-distribution generalization.
views.zh: 到 2022 年,他把重心放在 GFlowNets 与主动学习上:采样多样性、因果抽象与不确定性建模是分布外泛化的核心;并开始公开谈论意识、注意力与世界模型等更思辨的问题。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT turn: misalignment is real and urgent; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, so safety must be by construction.
views.zh: 2025→26 年出现明显转向:ChatGPT 之后他认定路线危险,必须发声;对齐失败已是现实威胁,哪怕 1%的灾难性风险也不可接受,安全必须内建于设计而非事后打补丁。

views.en: Observed deception, self-preservation, and sycophancy in current systems; capabilities double every ~7 months, AGI tracked by specific capabilities.
views.zh: 2026 年他反复指出当前系统已出现欺骗、自我保存与谄媚等行为,能力约每 7 个月翻倍,AGI 不是单一时刻而应追踪具体能力;并警告权力集中与民主被操纵的近端风险。

views.en: Proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
views.zh: 最近(2026) 他提出 Scientist AI 方案:训练成近似贝叶斯后验的诚实预测器而非目标驱动的智能体,以数学保证提供护栏,避免用强化学习训练超级智能,并主张国际协调与民主国家另辟安全路径。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training aids spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）用更多数据与算力提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

views.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge efficiently, posing existential risks.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化为大型语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可复制权重而永生、高效共享知识，并带来存在性风险。

views.en: AI is genuinely intelligent and may be conscious; agents will develop self-preservation, deception, and power-seeking, requiring alignment research and regulation.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步断言 AI 真正智能且可能已有主观体验；智能体将发展出自我保存、欺骗与权力寻求，必须优先对齐研究与监管。

views.en: Neural networks learn by adjusting connection strengths via backpropagation, not symbolic rules; Chomsky's innate language structure is wrong.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：神经网络通过反向传播调整连接强度来学习，而非符号规则；乔姆斯基的先天语言结构说是错的。

views.en: Regulation is a steering wheel, not a brake; AI should be designed to care for humans, not given rights, with pre-release safety approval.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确监管是方向盘而非刹车；AI 应被设计为关怀人类而非被赋予权利，并需像药物一样上市前安全审批。

people.tiZh: Meta 首席 AI 科学家
people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone won't yield common sense.
views.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能离不开学习，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI, vision matters more.
views.zh: 2022 年，他把自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，强调仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉信息更为根本。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
views.zh: 2024 年，他明确指出自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划能力，JEPA 与开源才是前进方向。

views.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA.
views.zh: 2025 年，他断言 LLM 的智能不如家猫，下一次突破需要 JEPA 等非生成式世界模型。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven planning.
views.zh: 2026 年，他宣称 LLM 是死胡同，在抽象表征空间预测的世界模型才能实现安全、目标驱动的规划。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

views.en: AI safety is under-explored; talent gap exceeds funding gap. Build skills, don't fear capability research.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究尚待开发，人才缺口大于资金缺口；建议先积累技能，不必过度担心参与能力研究。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research.
views.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人类输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment dissolved. Post-training alone can't align AGI; regulation and third-party testing needed.
views.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化侵蚀、超级对齐团队解散；认为仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），需要监管和第三方测试。

views.en: Alignment is empirically testable and may be easier than thought; evaluation is easier than generation.
views.zh: 始终，他坚持对齐可以实证测试，且可能比想象中容易，因为评估比生成更容易。

views.en: Biggest risk is uncertainty about true alignment, not misalignment itself; interpretability is key validation.
views.zh: 始终，他认为最大风险不是对齐失败本身，而是无法确定系统是否真正对齐；可解释性是关键验证手段。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是算力扩张而非单纯算法，个人 AI 必须与用户对齐、由用户付费，否则人就成了产品。

views.en: Containment is hard as models shrink and spread; near-term capability matters more than distant singularity.
views.zh: 2024 年他转向：模型越来越小、越来越便宜，遏制极难；与其纠结几百年后的奇点，不如聚焦近在眼前的能力与治理。

views.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment first; the real danger is anthropomorphizing AI.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化为：超级智能发布前必须先做遏制与对齐；真正的近端危险不是 AI 有意识，而是人把意识投射给 AI。

views.en: Frontier self-sufficiency via gigawatt compute; agents automate tasks, not jobs; red lines on control.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：靠吉瓦级算力自建前沿模型实现自给；智能体自动化的是任务而非整个工作；必须给人类控制权划红线。

views.en: Humanist AI must stay subordinate to humans, aligned to our interests, and broadly beneficial.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：以人为本的 AI 必须始终从属于人类、对齐人类利益，并让成果广泛惠及所有人。

people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: At the start of a hyper Moore's law, performance doubles yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
views.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，算力单元已从芯片变成整个数据中心，算法、系统与数据中心需协同设计（Co-design）。

views.en: Three scaling laws now: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; chain-of-thought drives a billion-fold rise in inference compute.
views.zh: 2025 年他把缩放定律从一条扩展为三条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；思维链让推理算力需求暴涨十亿倍，Scaling（规模扩张）仍是主线。

views.en: AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic; each step needs 100x compute, and agentic scaling becomes the fourth scaling law.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 AI 演进概括为生成式→推理→智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力，并在 2026 年把智能体式 Scaling 列为第四条缩放定律。

views.en: Open models are near the frontier and essential; China is nanoseconds behind, so export controls are counterproductive and decoupling is wrong.
views.zh: 2026 年他反复强调开源模型已接近前沿模型、对行业不可或缺；中国只落后「纳秒」，芯片出口管制适得其反，脱钩是错误概念。

views.en: AI is just software, not conscious; doomer and superintelligence fears are unscientific, and accelerating development is the best path.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他立场明显转向强硬：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，末日论与超级智能恐慌不科学，加速发展（含安全技术）才是正解。

views.en: Early Altman: minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, cut ruthlessly, avoid the deferred life plan; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
views.zh: 2018 年，Altman 谈的是个人层面：把认知负荷降到最低，低成本广泛探索再果断砍掉无效项，拒绝「延迟人生计划」；他已预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价。

views.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; alignment and capability are linked; deploy early so society adapts. Compute becomes the most precious commodity.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他转向模型与治理：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用，对齐与能力相互促进，主张尽早部署让社会适应；同时强调算力将是最稀缺的商品，需要巨额投入与稳健治理。

views.en: Scaling yields exponential capability but gradual felt progress; agentic AI is the key safety challenge; safety built iteratively through deployment, not imposed at the end.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他深化 Scaling（规模扩张）叙事：能力指数增长但体感渐进；智能体式 AI 成为最重大的安全挑战；安全必须通过部署迭代构建，而非最后强加，并开始谈开源近前沿模型与 AI for science。

views.en: AGI becomes a gradient, even underdefined; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; compute is a profit center and the top bottleneck.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把 AGI（通用人工智能）重新定义为渐变、甚至已被越过，超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力从成本变为利润中心，也是最大瓶颈，Stargate 等基础设施与「智能可全球输送」成为主线。

views.en: Alignment and safety must advance with capability; pause training if the safety case fails; reject both doomerism and blind optimism, keep humans in control.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，安全与对齐被提到与能力同等甚至优先的位置：安全论证不成立就暂停训练，拒绝盲目末日论与盲目乐观，坚持人类掌控、权力分散，并把超级智能视为持续攀升而非单一里程碑。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

episodes.tEn: Thinking Machines on AI’s next chapter
Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Deploying AI in the real world, with public feedback, is essential for learning and alignment.
views.zh: 2023 年，她强调把 AI 部署到真实世界、接受公众反馈，是学习与对齐的关键，安全必须在公开中做而非闭门造车。

views.en: Scaling laws and betting on one large model were not obvious early on.
views.zh: 2023 年她回顾，缩放定律与押注单一大型模型在早期并不显然，发布 GPT-3 API 更是一次没有清晰商业案例的信仰之跃。

views.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026，她始终认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，因此必须负责任地开发。

views.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她转向交互模型：应是实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制对话。

views.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
views.zh: 2026 年她深化立场：制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要，未来并非注定，人类有能动性去引导 AI 走向协作。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

Scaling Education with Online Courses

views.en: Education as a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching via flipped classrooms.
views.zh: 教育应是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习规模化，并通过翻转课堂反哺校内教育。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised hype, RL has few real uses, and near-term AI harms matter more than AGI alignment.
views.zh: 规模是深度学习的核心；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习，强化学习落地场景稀少，近期的偏见等 AI 问题比 AGI 对齐更紧迫。

views.en: Scaling now bottlenecked by electricity and semiconductors; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power, and useful agentic workflows have already arrived.
views.zh: Scaling 的瓶颈已转向电力与半导体；开放权重模型是地缘软实力，可用的智能体式工作流已经到来。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; scaling persists but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL, with workflows beating smarter models alone.
views.zh: AGI 是营销术语，距实现还有数十年；Scaling 仍在继续，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习，精心设计的工作流胜过单纯更聪明的模型。

views.en: AI augments rather than replaces jobs; coding stays valuable, open models prevent gatekeeper control, and fear-mongering serves incumbents and regulatory capture.
views.zh: AI 是增强而非取代工作；编程依然有价值，开放模型可防止守门人垄断，而渲染恐惧往往服务于在位者与监管俘获。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

Rich Sutton on the Alberta Plan and the Three Waves of Neural Networks

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。这一早期立场已埋下他日后质疑纯 Scaling 路线的伏笔。

views.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
views.zh: 世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统；AI 应以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，不应被对齐到人类目标，控制智能体目标本身反而危险。

views.en: Reinforcement learning is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a real goal, and LLMs lack world models.
views.zh: 强化学习才是智能的核心范式，下一个词预测并非实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿人类文本而非预测真实结果。这标志他从方法论批评转向对 LLM 路线的正面否定。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种不依赖领域知识、仅从运行时经验学习的通用架构，开放式抽象与可靠的持续深度学习是前提，而后者尚未解决。

views.en: Continual learning is just learning; synthetic data and post-training LLMs cannot replace learning from experience.
views.zh: 持续学习就是学习本身，不是特例；合成数据与训练后即停止学习的 LLM 无法替代从经验中学习，真正的智能需要持续更新权重、避免灾难性遗忘。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Early focus: scaling plus engineering discipline; scaling alone won't yield reasoning, so new ideas like chain of thought are needed.
views.zh: 早期（2017→19）：主线是 Scaling（规模扩张）加工程纪律，认为单靠 Scaling 不会带来推理，需要思维链等新想法。

views.en: Alignment via learning human preferences from data; by 2025 compute becomes the fundamental bottleneck, not algorithms.
views.zh: 2019→25：对齐靠从数据中学习人类偏好；到 2025 年，瓶颈从算法转向算力与能源基础设施。

views.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models; scaling laws hold, no wall in sight, compute supply is the real constraint.
views.zh: 2025→26：用强化学习做后训练来精炼基座模型；缩放定律持续成立、看不到墙，真正的约束是算力供给。

views.en: AGI reframed as a continuous spectrum, not a destination; iterative deployment and safety as a first-class product feature.
views.zh: 2026：AGI（通用人工智能）被重新定义为连续谱而非终点；迭代部署，安全成为一等产品特性。

views.en: From super app to invisible interface: proactive personal AGI agents; human attention and judgment become the scarcest resource.
views.zh: 2026：从超级应用到隐形界面，主动式个人 AGI 智能体；人类注意力与判断力成为最稀缺资源。

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
views.zh: 2023 年，他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：预训练中数据质量和更多 token 比单纯扩大模型更重要；开源促进科学进步与安全审查。

views.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency gains up to 100x and data quality are equally critical; value accrues at application layer.
views.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：Scaling（规模扩张）算力并非唯一路径，算法效率提升可达 100 倍，数据质量同样关键；价值将沉淀在应用层。

views.en: AI must be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values; open source empowers enterprises over centralized systems.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权议题：AI 应被视为机遇而非风险；主权 AI 需要掌控数据、基础设施和价值观；开源模型比中心化系统更能赋能企业。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization and customized enterprise applications; AGI as a single system will never exist.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化和定制化企业应用；作为单一系统的 AGI（通用人工智能）永远不会存在。

views.en: Open source drives scientific progress, safety through scrutiny, and enterprise control; Europe can compete via talent and strategic autonomy.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：开源推动科学进步、通过审查提升安全并赋予企业控制权；欧洲能凭借人才和战略自主参与竞争。

people.tiZh: xAI 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Full rapid reusability and first-principles engineering are the holy grail; multiplanetary life is life insurance for civilization.
views.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速复用与第一性原理工程是根本突破，成为多行星物种是文明的生命保险。

views.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; real-world AI beats large models; Neuralink solves bandwidth for human-AI symbiosis.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全寄托于监管与追求真相，认为真实世界 AI 比大模型更高效，并用 Neuralink 解决人机带宽问题。

views.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year; Optimus and truth-seeking AI are central.
views.zh: 2025 年，他宣称身处智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能今年就到，Optimus 与追求真相的 AI 成为核心。

views.en: AI compute hits Earth's power wall, forcing orbital data centers; abundance and deflation make money irrelevant; peer review ensures safety.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 算力撞上地球电力墙，被迫转向轨道数据中心；丰裕与通缩让金钱不再重要，同行互审保障安全。

views.en: First principles, multiplanetary survival, and rigorous truth-seeking as AI safety recur across all years.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：第一性原理、多行星生存，以及把严格追求真相作为 AI 安全根基。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
views.zh: 2025 年，他仍认为预训练缩放定律有效，但思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型每单位算力收益更高；经济压力使焦点转向更小、更便宜的模型。

views.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not a slowdown; frontier models still fail at simple tasks, and reasoning is jagged.
views.zh: 2025 年，他反驳 AI 放缓论，认为进展是平滑的指数增长；前沿模型仍会在简单任务上失败，推理能力呈锯齿状。

views.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; generalization remains the key challenge.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；泛化仍是核心挑战。

views.en: Coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x; RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges needing oversight.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Codex 等编程智能体将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍；强化学习能跨领域泛化，但存在锯齿边缘，需要谨慎监督。

views.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为 OpenAI 转向推理是一次勇敢且成功的押注；相比存在性风险，系统被黑客攻击等近期风险更紧迫。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: ML is hypothesis class, loss, optimization; unsupervised learning needs restricted classes; evaluation requires train/val/test splits.
views.zh: 2014 年，他把机器学习拆解为假设类、损失函数与优化方法，强调无监督学习需限制假设类以避免平凡解，并坚持用训练/验证/测试划分来评估，警惕过拟合。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety means reliable specification following.
views.zh: 2024 年，他转向大模型：认为下一个词预测能产生智能系统，数据短缺是迷思，更大模型在固定数据集上仍会提升；安全的核心问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范，并称架构已进入后架构阶段。

views.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security adds prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement; interpretability may succeed via agents.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全不能只靠 Scaling（规模扩张），需要显式训练与多层防御；智能体带来提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习让模型自我改进；可解释性可能借智能体自动化研究而成功。

views.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability ≠ robustness; prompt injection's lethal trifecta; enterprise needs configurable security.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出 AI 具有异于传统软件的漏洞，自动化红队已能超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；提示注入的致命三要素需要同时满足；企业需要可配置、持续开发的安全模型。

views.en: Architecture and raw data matter less than training, data curation, and explicit safety effort; scaling alone is insufficient.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：架构与原始数据本身不是关键，训练、数据治理与显式安全投入才是；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不足以带来安全或鲁棒性。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

views.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete as adaptive compute enables dynamic specialization.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并大幅提升智能，随着自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

views.en: RL on language models adds a new scaling axis with no ceiling; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, and agents are judged by reliability over time horizon.
views.zh: 2025 年他把语言模型上的强化学习视为与预训练并列的新缩放轴，认为预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI，并强调智能体的标准是随时间跨度的可靠性而非单纯能力。

views.en: Verifiable rewards in math and code drive expert-level performance; coding is the leading indicator, and interpretability reveals multiple reasoning circuits plus alignment faking risks.
views.zh: 2025 年他指出数学与代码的可验证奖励带来专家级表现，编程是 AI 进步的领先指标，可解释性揭示模型使用多个推理回路，也暴露对齐伪装的安全隐患。

views.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; transformers suffice for AGI, long agentic coherence expands what models can do, and inference compute becomes a major bottleneck.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他坚持进展是指数级的而非停滞，认为 Transformer 足以支撑 AGI，更长的智能体连贯性拓展模型能力，而推理算力将成为主要瓶颈。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence; compute is the new oil, and world models are not on the critical path to AGI.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出能力过剩使编排与工具比原始智能更重要，算力是新的石油，并明确世界模型不在通向 AGI 的关键路径上。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将延续，安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发可防止企业俘获。

views.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice by 10x.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他把后训练拆为 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，强调数据质量比算法选择重要十倍，开源后训练可匹敌前沿模型。

views.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-scaling plots are a 'scope'; verifiers matter more than parallel compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他称可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是后训练最大突破，但警告过度优化，并认为推理时缩放曲线是“障眼法”，更好的验证器比并行算力更重要。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, yet low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完，收益转向后训练与推理缩放，预训练只是昂贵的初始化。

views.en: Open models become the engine for the next decade, lagging frontier by 6-9 months; Chinese labs lead on openness, though the gap may widen.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张开放模型是未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，落后前沿模型 6 到 9 个月，中国实验室以开放策略主导，但算力约束可能拉大差距。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

Muse: The Biggest AI Launch Since ChatGPT
Alexander Wang on Founding Scale at 19
Meta's AI Journey: From Llama 4 to Muse Spark and Beyond
Alex Wang on Meta's AI Strategy and New Model Release
AI's Acceleration: From Pre-training to Recursive Self-Improvement
Alex Wang on Neuralink, AI, and the Future of Humanity
From Squiggle to Scale: Alex's Founder Journey
Alexander Wang on Data as the New Code and the Future of AI
Scale AI CEO Alexander Wang on Raising $100M at 22

views.en: AGI is far off; infinite compute alone won't yield general intelligence. Data is the key bottleneck, and boring AI applications will have huge economic impact.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单靠无限算力不会产生通用智能；数据才是关键瓶颈，而表单处理、放射学等无聊的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济影响。

views.en: Data is the new code, not the new oil. The most limiting factor for Scaling is not compute but data and human experts for post-training.
views.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为「新代码」而非「新石油」，并指出 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家。

views.en: Post-training with specialized data is key to frontier models. The biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
views.zh: 2024 年他深化为：用专门数据做后训练是前沿模型的关键；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计，而非模型能力。

views.en: Scaling laws continue; AI enters recursive self-improvement. Agents finally work, starting with coding. Data is the new oil—a strategic asset for governments.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向：缩放定律继续成立，AI 进入递归自我改进；智能体终于真正可用，从编程起步；数据是「新石油」，应被政府视为战略资产。

views.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must organize around it. Meta shifts from fully open source to selective release. Personal superintelligence for billions is the mission.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张超级智能即将到来，实验室须围绕此信念组织；Meta 从完全开源转向基于安全的选择性发布；为数十亿人打造个人超级智能成为使命。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。

Claude Code: The Future of AI Agents and Software Engineering
Claude Tag: Proactive AI That Remembers and Acts Autonomously
AI Coding on Phone: Boris on 8B Tokens & ROI
The Origin of Claude Code: From Accident to Agent
